name: rokctapp_composer
description: Configuration list of active SDKs for paas_driver

sdks.name: base_sdk
sdks._comment: Shared kernel (replaces retired core_sdk); provides the app shell templates.

sdks.name: auth_sdk
sdks._comment: Fully installed (skip_install lifted, plan M3, mirrors manager.json): auth_sdk is the source of truth for auth. Its route shells generate LoginRoute/RegisterRoute/etc. - the host's own auth pages are deleted in the same commit, so there is no duplicate-route collision. delivery_sdk's app_type.driver session_policy (deliveryman -> /home, '*' fallback -> /become-driver keeping the session) gates login via the installed auth_session_policy.dart shell.

sdks.name: telemetry_sdk
sdks._comment: App telemetry: events flow through base_sdk's TelemetryClient.track gateway cmd, with telemetry_sdk owning delivery policy via the TelemetryClient.configure transport seam. Pin = sha256 of core telemetry/dart/install.py as bootstrapped, same value as radio.json's entry.

sdks.name: calc_sdk
sdks._comment: Standalone calculator (productivity PR #4); un-gated /calc route, shared by manager and driver.

sdks.name: weather_sdk
sdks._comment: Activates the severe-weather banner shipped dormant in zones PR #44: weather 1.4.0's app_type.driver block installs the courier locationResolver wiring plus the weather-driver-configure-location boot hook, and delivery_sdk's home sheet already renders the warnings banner fail-closed. Declaration mirrors manager.json.

sdks.name: agent_sdk
sdks._sha256_comment: SHA-256 of agent/dart/install.py at agent@798de2da; required by the composer's unpinned-installer gate. Update when upstream install.py changes.

sdks.name: revenue_sdk
sdks._comment: Driver income/statistics pages, under a driver/ role folder with an app_type.driver manifest block. Shared with manager.json, which takes the manager variant from the same SDK.

sdks.name: merchants_sdk
sdks._comment: Story UI the driver app shows; base_sdk already owns story_data/story_request, so only the presentation needed a home.

sdks.name: products_sdk
sdks._comment: restaurant_item / product_item / maps_list widgets used by the driver app.

sdks.name: desktop_sdk
sdks._comment: TEMPORARY (desktop testing convenience, revert candidate): added to every app profile so all composed apps pull desktop support and can be viewed/tested on desktop. Pin = sha256 of hardware desktop/dart/install.py at main head 84aa6ed, same value as supacharge.json's entry.

sdks.name: hms_sdk
sdks._comment: Huawei Mobile Services support, built like desktop_sdk (SDK module, not productFlavors). Dart-side: DeviceServices ({gms, hms, neither} detection, cached, fail-open to gms) and an order-30 boot hook that, ONLY on GMS-free HMS-capable devices, boots Push Kit and registers the HMS push token through the same api.user.register_device_token gateway cmd the FCM token uses (provider 'hms'). No installs - the BUILD_HMS-gated AGConnect Gradle wiring lives statically in core's android template, default-off. Strict no-op in every plain GMS build.

_host_routes_comment: Deliberately empty, declared explicitly (supacharge precedent, mirrors manager.json): paas_driver tracks NO router copy after migration M4 - compose generates app_router.dart wholly from base_sdk's template plus each installed SDK's manifest routes. Every former host-owned route migrated to an SDK manifest (delivery_sdk's courier vertical incl. /home and /become-driver, auth_sdk's login/register/reset + /registration-steps, comms_sdk's /list-notification, zones_sdk's /delivery-zone, revenue_sdk's /income, merchants_sdk's /story, calc_sdk's /calc). Anything ADR-005-shaped a future driver feature needs goes HERE as data, never back into a tracked router file.
